summary: The bad() method computes a SHA-512 digest of a fixed value without any salt (CWE-759 Unsalted One-Way Hash). The fix generates a random salt with the already-imported SecureRandom and mixes it into the digest via hash.update(salt) before hashing the input. This preserves the feature (still computes and writes a SHA-512 hash of "hash me") while making the hash salted.
